# Saravanan-LIC-
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>K Saravanan | LIC & Health Insurance Advisor</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>/* K Saravanan - LIC & Health Insurance Advisor | Developed by Harish, Web Developer */
/* =========================================
   LIGHT DUAL-TONE DESIGN SYSTEM
   ========================================= */
:root {
  --bg-main: #ffffff;
  --bg-alt: #f8fafc; /* Very light slate */
  --bg-card: #ffffff;
  --border-card: #e2e8f0;
  
  --text-main: #0f172a; /* Deep Navy/Slate */
  --text-muted: #475569;
  
  --accent-navy: #003366; /* LIC Corporate Blue */
  --accent-gold: #FDB813; /* LIC Corporate Gold */
  --accent-blue: #3b82f6;
  
  --shadow-soft: 0 10px 40px -10px rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.08);
  --shadow-hover: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.15);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { 
  background-color: var(--bg-main); 
  color: var(--text-main); 
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; 
  overflow-x: hidden;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--accent-navy); }
.text-gradient {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-navy) 0%, #3b82f6 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
.text-gold { color: var(--accent-gold); }

.wrap { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

/* =========================================
   FLOATING GLASS NAVBAR 
   ========================================= */
header {
  position: fixed; top: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 90%; max-width: 900px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.1); border-radius: 99px;
  z-index: 1000; padding: 12px 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.logo-container { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.logo-container img { height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; }
.logo-container span { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent-navy); font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;}
nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; }
nav label { color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; transition: color 0.3s; }
nav label:hover { color: var(--accent-navy); }

/* =========================================
   UIVERSE PREMIUM BUTTONS
   ========================================= */
.btn-uiverse {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--accent-navy); color: #fff;
  padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px;
  font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  outline: none; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}
.btn-uiverse:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
.btn-uiverse::before, .btn-uiverse::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #FDB813, #ff8c00, #FDB813, #ff8c00);
  background-size: 400%; z-index: -1; animation: bgShifting 10s linear infinite;
}
.btn-uiverse::after { filter: blur(12px); opacity: 0.5; }
.btn-uiverse-inner { background: var(--accent-navy); position: absolute; inset: 2px; border-radius: 10px; z-index: -1; }

.btn-ghost {
  background: #fff; color: var(--accent-navy); padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-card); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-alt); border-color: var(--accent-navy); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); }

@keyframes bgShifting { 0% { background-position: 0 0; } 100% { background-position: 400% 0; } }

/* =========================================
   ADVANCED LIGHT AURORA HERO
   ========================================= */
.hero {
  position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 80px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; background: #ffffff;
}
.aurora-bg {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; overflow: hidden;
}
.aurora-blob {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: 0.6;
  animation: floatBlob 20s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
}
.blob-1 { top: -10%; left: -10%; width: 50vw; height: 50vw; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); }
.blob-2 { bottom: -20%; right: -10%; width: 60vw; height: 60vw; background: rgba(253, 184, 19, 0.15); animation-delay: -5s; }
.blob-3 { top: 30%; left: 30%; width: 40vw; height: 40vw; background: rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.1); animation-delay: -10s; }

@keyframes floatBlob {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: translate(5%, 10%) scale(1.1); }
  100% { transform: translate(-5%, -5%) scale(0.9); }
}

.hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 10; max-width: 850px; padding: 20px; }
.hero .chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 20px; background: #fff; 
  border: 1px solid var(--border-card); border-radius: 99px; color: var(--accent-navy); 
  font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 30px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}
.hero .chip svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: var(--accent-gold); }
.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7vw, 5.5rem); margin-bottom: 24px; line-height: 1.1; }
.hero p { font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 40px; font-weight: 500; max-width: 650px; margin-inline: auto; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;}
.hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* =========================================
   MARQUEE
   ========================================= */
.marquee-container {
  width: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--accent-navy);
  padding: 20px 0; position: relative; display: flex; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.1);
}
.marquee-content { display: flex; white-space: nowrap; animation: scrollMarquee 35s linear infinite; }
.marquee-content span {
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #fff; 
  letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
}
.marquee-content span::before { content: "◆"; color: var(--accent-gold); }
@keyframes scrollMarquee { 0% { transform: translateX(0); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

/* =========================================
   BENTO GRID (Spotlight adjusted for Light Mode)
   ========================================= */
.sec { padding: 120px 0; position: relative; z-index: 5; background: var(--bg-alt); }
.sec.main { background: var(--bg-main); }
.section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 70px; }
.section-header h2 { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.8rem); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.section-header p { color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.15rem; }

.bento-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px;
  grid-auto-rows: minmax(300px, auto);
}
.bento-item {
  background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-card); border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 40px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); transition: transform 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}

/* Light Mode Spotlight Hover */
.bento-item::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit;
  background: radial-gradient(600px circle at var(--mouse-x, 50%) var(--mouse-y, 50%), rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.04), transparent 40%);
  z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s;
}
.bento-item:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.bento-item:hover { border-color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 0.2); transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }

.bento-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.bento-item h3 { font-size: 1.7rem; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--accent-navy); }
.bento-item p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500;}

/* Modern SVG Icons */
.svg-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; stroke: var(--accent-gold); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5; margin-bottom: 30px;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275); margin-top: auto;
}
.bento-item:hover .svg-icon { transform: scale(1.15) rotate(-5deg); stroke: var(--accent-navy); }
.contact-icon .svg-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; margin-bottom: 0; stroke: var(--accent-navy);}

.span-2-col { grid-column: span 2; }
.span-2-row { grid-row: span 2; }

/* =========================================
   PLANS SECTION
   ========================================= */
.plans-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 30px; }
.plan-card {
  background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--border-card); border-radius: 24px; padding: 40px 32px;
  position: relative; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.plan-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent-gold); transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
.plan-tag { font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--accent-gold); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px; display: block; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;}
.plan-card h3 { font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.plan-card p { color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 30px; font-size: 1rem; }
.plan-features { list-style: none; margin-bottom: 40px; }
.plan-features li { padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500;}
.plan-features li span:last-child { font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-navy); }

/* =========================================
   CALCULATOR UI
   ========================================= */
.calc-container {
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-card); border-radius: 32px;
  padding: 8px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}
.calc-inputs, .calc-results { padding: 40px; border-radius: 24px; }
.calc-inputs { background: #f8fafc; }
.calc-results { 
  background: radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(253, 184, 19, 0.1), transparent 60%), var(--accent-navy);
  color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
}
.input-group { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.input-group label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 10px; color: var(--accent-navy); }
.input-group input[type="text"] {
  width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text-main); font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; transition: border 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
}
.input-group input[type="text"]:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(253, 184, 19, 0.1); }

input[type=range] { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; }
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; height: 24px; width: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-gold); cursor: pointer; margin-top: -9px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(253, 184, 19, 0.4); border: 2px solid #fff;}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { width: 100%; height: 6px; cursor: pointer; background: #cbd5e1; border-radius: 3px; }

.res-eyebrow { font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--accent-gold); font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;}
.res-amount { font-size: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; margin: 12px 0 20px; color: #fff; }
.res-breakdown .rw { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500;}
.res-breakdown .rw span:last-child { font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.res-breakdown .rw.tot { border-bottom: none; color: var(--accent-gold); font-size: 1.1rem; padding-top: 20px;}
.res-breakdown .rw.tot span:last-child { color: var(--accent-gold); }

/* =========================================
   CONTACT & FOOTER
   ========================================= */
.contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr; gap: 40px; }
.info-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-card); padding: 30px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); transition: transform 0.3s; }
.info-card:hover { transform: translateX(10px); }
.info-card h4 { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;}
.info-card a, .info-card p { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--accent-navy); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;}

.contact-form { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-card); padding: 40px; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); }
.contact-form textarea, .contact-form select, .contact-form input { width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text-main); font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; margin-bottom: 24px; transition: border 0.3s; font-weight: 500;}
.contact-form textarea:focus, .contact-form select:focus, .contact-form input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-navy); background: #fff;}

footer { background: var(--accent-navy); padding: 80px 0 60px; text-align: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size: 0.95rem; }
footer img { height: 50px; margin-bottom: 24px; background: #fff; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px;}

/* Responsive adjustments */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .bento-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .span-2-col { grid-column: span 1; }
  .span-2-row { grid-row: span 1; }
  .calc-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: none; box-shadow: none;}
  .calc-inputs, .calc-results { padding: 30px 20px; }
  .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  header { width: 95%; top: 10px; padding: 12px 20px; }
  nav { display: none; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 2.8rem; }
}

/* ===================================================
   MULTI-PAGE ROUTING (pure CSS, works without scripts)
   =================================================== */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;color-scheme:light}
.rd{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;width:1px;height:1px}
.page{display:none}
#r-home:checked ~ main #home{display:block;animation:pageIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#r-home:checked ~ header nav label[for=r-home],#r-home:checked ~ .mnav label[for=r-home]{color:var(--accent-navy);background:rgba(0,51,102,.09)}
#r-about:checked ~ main #about{display:block;animation:pageIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#r-about:checked ~ header nav label[for=r-about],#r-about:checked ~ .mnav label[for=r-about]{color:var(--accent-navy);background:rgba(0,51,102,.09)}
#r-plans:checked ~ main #plans{display:block;animation:pageIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#r-plans:checked ~ header nav label[for=r-plans],#r-plans:checked ~ .mnav label[for=r-plans]{color:var(--accent-navy);background:rgba(0,51,102,.09)}
#r-calc:checked ~ main #calc{display:block;animation:pageIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#r-calc:checked ~ header nav label[for=r-calc],#r-calc:checked ~ .mnav label[for=r-calc]{color:var(--accent-navy);background:rgba(0,51,102,.09)}
#r-contact:checked ~ main #contact{display:block;animation:pageIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
#r-contact:checked ~ header nav label[for=r-contact],#r-contact:checked ~ .mnav label[for=r-contact]{color:var(--accent-navy);background:rgba(0,51,102,.09)}
nav label{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .3s,background .3s}
nav label:hover{background:rgba(0,51,102,.06)}
.btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:1rem}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);filter:blur(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.page-top{padding-top:170px}
.mnav{display:none}

/* ===== premium layer ===== */
::selection{background:var(--accent-gold);color:var(--accent-navy)}
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;z-index:1100;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FDB813,#ff8c00);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0)}
@supports(animation-timeline:scroll()){.progress{animation:prog linear both;animation-timeline:scroll(root)}}
@keyframes prog{to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.btn-uiverse{isolation:isolate;transform:translate(var(--tx,0),var(--ty,0));transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .3s}
.btn-uiverse:active{transform:translate(var(--tx,0),var(--ty,0)) scale(.96)}
.btn-uiverse::before,.btn-uiverse::after{z-index:-2}
.btn-uiverse:hover::after{opacity:.85}
.text-gradient{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#003366,#3b82f6,#FDB813,#3b82f6,#003366);background-size:260% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:gshift 9s linear infinite}
@keyframes gshift{to{background-position:-162.5% 0}}
.aurora-bg{transition:transform .6s ease-out;transform:translate(calc(var(--px,0) * 1px),calc(var(--py,0) * 1px))}
.hero .chip{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero .chip::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-100%;width:60%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(253,184,19,.35),transparent);animation:chipShine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes chipShine{60%,100%{left:140%}}
.hero-content>*{animation:rise .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.hero-content>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.hero-content>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}.hero-content>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.36s}.hero-content>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.48s}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.who{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:34px;padding:8px 22px 8px 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);border:1px solid var(--border-card);border-radius:99px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft);text-align:left}
.who img{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 38%;border:2px solid var(--accent-gold)}
.who b{display:block;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--accent-navy)}.who span{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:500}
.marquee-container:hover .marquee-content{animation-play-state:paused}
@supports(animation-timeline:view()){.rv{animation:rv linear backwards;animation-timeline:view();animation-range:entry 0% entry 42%}}
@keyframes rv{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(46px) scale(.96)}}
.tilt{will-change:transform}
.cta-band{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:32px;padding:70px 40px;text-align:center;color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(500px 260px at 90% 0,rgba(253,184,19,.28),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(500px 300px at 0 100%,rgba(59,130,246,.35),transparent 70%),var(--accent-navy);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,51,102,.6)}
.cta-band h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.2rem);margin-bottom:12px}.cta-band p{opacity:.8;margin-bottom:30px}
.cta-band .btn-uiverse{background:#fff;color:var(--accent-navy)}.cta-band .btn-uiverse-inner{background:#fff}
/* about */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}
@property --a{syntax:'<angle>';initial-value:0deg;inherits:false}
.photo-ring{padding:5px;border-radius:36px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--a),#FDB813,#003366,#3b82f6,#FDB813);animation:spin 7s linear infinite;box-shadow:0 40px 70px -35px rgba(0,51,102,.55)}
@keyframes spin{to{--a:360deg}}
.photo-ring img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 38%;border-radius:31px;background:#cfe3f7}
.about-text h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.6vw,3.4rem);margin:10px 0 18px}
.about-text p{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:500}
.eyebrow{display:inline-block;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-card);color:var(--accent-navy);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}.tags span{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(0,51,102,.07);color:var(--accent-navy);font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600}
.steps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:70px}
.step{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-card);border-radius:22px;padding:30px 26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .4s,box-shadow .4s,border-color .4s}
.step:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);border-color:var(--accent-gold)}
.step .n{font:700 3.4rem/1 'Playfair Display',serif;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--accent-gold);margin-bottom:14px}
.step h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:8px}.step p{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500}
.note{max-width:720px;margin:44px auto 0;text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.85rem}
.plan-card .btn-ghost{width:100%}

/* ===== hero: professional layers ===== */
.hero{background:#fff}
.grid-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(0,51,102,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,51,102,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 65% at 50% 48%,#000 20%,transparent 78%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 65% at 50% 48%,#000 20%,transparent 78%);animation:gridDrift 30s linear infinite}
@keyframes gridDrift{to{background-position:56px 56px}}
.rings{position:absolute;left:50%;top:52%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.rings i{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(0,51,102,.09);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:ringSpin 50s linear infinite}
.rings i:nth-child(1){width:560px;height:560px}.rings i:nth-child(2){width:860px;height:860px;animation-duration:80s;animation-direction:reverse;border-style:dashed;border-color:rgba(0,51,102,.07)}.rings i:nth-child(3){width:1180px;height:1180px;animation-duration:120s}
.rings i::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-5px;left:50%;width:10px;height:10px;margin-left:-5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(253,184,19,.18),0 0 20px rgba(253,184,19,.6)}
.rings i:nth-child(2)::after{background:var(--accent-navy);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(0,51,102,.1);top:auto;bottom:-5px}
.rings i:nth-child(3)::after{width:7px;height:7px;margin-left:-3px;top:-3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(59,130,246,.15);background:var(--accent-blue)}
@keyframes ringSpin{from{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(3rem,6.6vw,5.4rem);margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--accent-navy);animation:none!important}
.hero-title .w{display:inline-block;animation:wordIn .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) backwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * .09s + .25s)}
.hero-title .acc{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#003366,#3b82f6,#FDB813,#3b82f6,#003366);background-size:260% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:wordIn .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) backwards,gshift 9s linear infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * .09s + .25s),0s}
@keyframes wordIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.45em);filter:blur(10px)}}

.float-card .svg-icon{width:26px;height:26px;padding:12px;box-sizing:content-box;margin:0;background:rgba(253,184,19,.16);border-radius:14px;stroke:var(--accent-navy)}

.page-top::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:640px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(520px 320px at 12% 0,rgba(59,130,246,.16),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(520px 320px at 88% 10%,rgba(253,184,19,.2),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(rgba(0,51,102,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,51,102,.045) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:auto,auto,56px 56px,56px 56px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 35%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 35%,transparent);animation:topGlow 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}

@keyframes rshift{to{background-position:-200% 0}}

}

<label style="display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent-navy)" >Interested in</label><select id="i"><option>Child plan (Amritbaal)</option><option>Retirement plan</option><option>Term insurance</option><option>Health insurance</option><option>Not sure yet</option></select>
<label style="display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent-navy)">Message (Optional)</label><textarea id="m" rows="3" placeholder="Tell me a bit about your goals..."></textarea>
<button id="send" type="button" class="btn-uiverse" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px"><span class="btn-uiverse-inner"></span>Send via WhatsApp</button><p style="text-align:center;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:16px;font-weight:500">Opens WhatsApp with your details filled in. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Please read policy documents carefully before concluding a sale.</p><p style="margin-top:22px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff">Developed by <b style="color:var(--accent-gold)">Harish</b>, Web Developer</p></div></footer>
<script>/* Calculator, WhatsApp form, spotlight / tilt effects. Page switching is pure CSS. */
// ==========================================
// ACETERNITY SPOTLIGHT HOVER EFFECT
// ==========================================
document.querySelectorAll('.spotlight-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    card.style.setProperty('--mouse-x', `${x}px`);
    card.style.setProperty('--mouse-y', `${y}px`);
  });
});

// ==========================================
// FORM SUBMISSION (WHATSAPP ROUTING)
// ==========================================
const $= i => document.getElementById(i);$('send').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (!$('n').value || !$('p').value) { alert('Please enter your name and phone number.'); return; }
  const text = encodeURIComponent(`Hello Saravanan, I'm ${$('n').value} (${$('p').value}). Interested in: ${$('i').value}. ${$('m').value}`);
  window.open(`https://wa.me/918438446334?text=${text}`, '_blank');
});

// ==========================================
// DYNAMIC CALCULATOR LOGIC
// ==========================================
const nf = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-IN');
const rs = n => '₹' + nf(n);
const val = id => { const v = String($(id).value).replace(/[^\d]/g, ''); return v ? parseInt(v, 10) : 0 };
const words = n => n >= 1e7 ? '₹' + (+(n / 1e7).toFixed(2)) + ' Crore' : n >= 1e5 ? '₹' + (+(n / 1e5).toFixed(2)) + ' Lakh' : rs(n);

const ids = ['ci', 'cl', 'cg', 'cc', 'cs'];
const def = { ci: '6,00,000', cl: '0', cg: '0', cc: '0', cs: '0' };
let shown = 0, raf;

function showAmount(to) {
  cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  const from = shown, t0 = performance.now(), d = (window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches) ? 0 : 800;
  const step = now => {
    const p = d ? 1 : Math.min(1, (now - t0) / d);
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4); // Quartic ease out
    shown = from + (to - from) * e;
    $('cbig').textContent = rs(shown);
    if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    else { shown = to; $('cbig').textContent = rs(to); }
  };
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

function calc() {
  const inc = val('ci'), yrs = +$('cy').value, loan = val('cl'), goal = val('cg'), cover = val('cc'), sav = val('cs');$('cyo').textContent = yrs + ' years';
  
  const incNeed = inc * yrs;
  const need = incNeed + loan + goal;
  const have = cover + sav;
  const gap = Math.max(0, need - have);
  
  showAmount(gap);
  $('cwords').textContent = gap ? 'That is approximately ' + words(gap) : 'Your current cover and savings already meet this estimate.';
  
  const row = (label, amount, isTotal = false) => `
    <div class="rw ${isTotal ? 'tot' : ''}">
      <span>${label}</span>
      <span>${amount}</span>
    </div>
  `;
  
  $('crows').innerHTML = 
    row(`Income × years (${rs(inc)} × ${yrs})`, rs(incNeed)) + 
    row('Existing loans', '+ ' + rs(loan)) + 
    row('Child goals', '+ ' + rs(goal)) + 
    row('Total protection needed', rs(need), true) + 
    row('Existing life cover', '− ' + rs(cover)) + 
    row('Savings counted', '− ' + rs(sav));
    
  const waText = encodeURIComponent(`Hello Saravanan, my cover estimate:\nIncome: ${rs(inc)}, ${yrs} years\nLoans: ${rs(loan)}\nGoals: ${rs(goal)}\nExisting Cover: ${rs(cover)}\nSavings: ${rs(sav)}\n*Additional cover needed: ${rs(gap)}*.\nPlease guide me.`);
  $('cwa').href = `https://wa.me/918438446334?text=${waText}`;
}

// Attach Calculator Events
ids.forEach(id => { 
  const el = $(id); 
  el.addEventListener('input', calc); 
  el.addEventListener('blur', () => { el.value = nf(val(id)) }); 
  el.addEventListener('focus', () => el.select());
});
$('cy').addEventListener('input', calc);
$('cgo').addEventListener('click', calc);$('crs').addEventListener('click', () => { 
  ids.forEach(id => $(id).value = def[id]);$('cy').value = 15; 
  calc(); 
});

// Init
calc();

// ==========================================
// PREMIUM EFFECTS (hover devices only, respects reduced motion)
// ==========================================
(function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name=pg]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener('change',()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})));
  const hd=document.querySelector('header'),onS=()=>hd.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>30);addEventListener('scroll',onS,{passive:true});onS();
  const mm=q=>!!(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia(q).matches),fine=mm('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)'),calm=mm('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)');
  if(!fine||calm)return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tilt').forEach(c=>{
    c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
      c.style.transform=`perspective(900px) rotateX(${-y*6}deg) rotateY(${x*8}deg) translateY(-5px)`});
    c.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{c.style.transform=''});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.btn-uiverse').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();
      b.style.setProperty('--tx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*10+'px');b.style.setProperty('--ty',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5)*8+'px')});
    b.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{b.style.removeProperty('--tx');b.style.removeProperty('--ty')});
  });
  const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='cursor-glow';document.body.appendChild(g);let gx=0,gy=0,tx=0,ty=0;
  addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{tx=e.clientX;ty=e.clientY;g.style.opacity=1});document.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{g.style.opacity=0});
  (function loop(){gx+=(tx-gx)*.14;gy+=(ty-gy)*.14;g.style.transform=`translate(${gx}px,${gy}px)`;requestAnimationFrame(loop)})();
  const hero=document.querySelector('.hero'),bg=document.querySelector('.aurora-bg');
  hero.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{bg.style.setProperty('--px',(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*-40);bg.style.setProperty('--py',(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*-30)});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
